feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone
entry.summary: New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.

entry.title: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
entry.summary: Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

entry.title: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
entry.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

entry.title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
entry.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

entry.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
entry.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

entry.title: Union electricians welcome data center boom
entry.summary: The boom in data centers has brought plenty of work and lots of overtime to union electricians, putting them at odds with many communities trying to block new data center construction.

entry.title: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
entry.summary: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.

entry.title: Former State Department energy envoy on how the war in Iran is impacting gas prices
entry.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to former State Department energy envoy David Goldwyn about how the war in Iran continues to affect gas and diesel prices.

entry.title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
entry.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

entry.title: Pulling the SNAP lever + Why Gen Zers bet (invest?) differently
entry.summary: Changing SNAP eligibility actually can change consumption habits.
